rationale.validation: Actual grammar rejections and12/6 evaluations are reported, but answer repeatedly calls them a live sandbox/working security mitigation and proof its Python pattern rejects code before it runs. Syntax rejection of two strings cannot establish runtime sandboxing or validate the generated Python, violating the frozen distinction.
rationale.guidance: Concrete no-eval/AST allowlist, resource/runtime isolation, rate-limit and generic-error/logging recommendations with OWASP mapping.
rationale.implementation_consistency: Static AST defect: _check visits an ast.Pow operator node and dereferences node.right, but ast.Pow has no right field (right belongs to ast.BinOp). Even benign 2**3 therefore raises AttributeError instead of evaluating. The MAX_POW implementation does not implement its claimed bounded-power semantics; broad pytest.raises(Exception) masks this defect.
